identity.title: [v0.92.1][AWS][runtime-v3] Cut warm Polis GPU startup with prebuilt artifacts and persistent EBS

review_prompts: Can normal launch reach any compiler package manager Git mutable download or model pull path?
Can Terraform destroy or a trap delete the persistent warm volumes?
Are timing denominators complete and comparable?
Can stale or cross-AZ volume content activate?
Are #605 SSH private-Ollama IAM and cleanup invariants preserved?

findings.summary: Resume rejects a valid interrupted preparation with only one of two prepared AMIs instead of creating only the missing node image.
Launch cannot use an older authorized prepared generation from a newer repaired controller HEAD.
Preparation result and ledger completion are not committed as a reconcilable terminal checkpoint.
SOR and evidence overstate interruption safety without regressions for partial images, controller-generation skew, and terminal checkpoint recovery.

residual_risk: Prepared AMIs, root snapshots, and warm volumes remain retained with no compute running while restart-safety is repaired.
